_about: Public-domain Joseph Benson (1749-1821), Wesleyan Methodist preacher and commentator, for the Word Hoard: Two Sermons on Sanctification (1782), Remarks on Dr. Priestley's System of Materialism (1788), A Defence of the Methodists (1793), An Apology for the People called Methodists (1801), Sermons on Various Occasions (vol. 1, 1802; vol. 2, 1836) The Life of the Rev. John de la Flechere (1820) and, from round 57, three volumes of his Commentary on the Holy Bible in the American edition (Old Testament vol. 3, New Testament vols 1-2), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 52 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

benson-sanctification: Two sermons, on sanctification. By Joseph Benson.  1782 (catalogued 1782)
benson-priestley: Remarks on Dr. Priestley's system of materialism, mechanism, and necessity, in a series of letters to the Reverend Mr. Wesley, introductory to an essay towards the proof of an immortal spirit in man.  1788 (catalogued 1788)
benson-defence-of-methodists: A defence of the Methodists, in five letters, addressed to the Rev. Dr. Tatham, containing sundry remarks on a late discourse, preached by that gentleman at four of the churches in Oxford, and entitled "A sermon suitable to the times." By Joseph Benson.  1793 (catalogued 1793)
benson-apology: An apology for the people called Methodists : containing a concise account of their origin and progress, doctrine, discipline, and designs, humbly submitted to the consideration of the friends of true Christianity (London : Printed by G. Story ..., sold by G. Whitfield [and 5 others], 1801)
benson-sermons-1: Sermons on various occasions : and most of them on the principal subjects of genuine Christianity (London : Printed at the Conference Office, G. Story, Agent, sold by G. Whitefield, and at the Methodist preaching houses in town and country, 1802)
benson-sermons-2: Sermons on various occasions, and most of them on the principal subjects of genuine Christianity, vol. 2 (London, J. Mason, 1836)
benson-life-of-fletcher: The Life of the Rev. John de la Flechere, compiled from the narratives of the Rev. Mr. Wesley ... (1820)
benson-commentary-ot-3: The Holy Bible ... with critical, explanatory, and practical notes, vol. 3: Ecclesiastes to Malachi (New York: George Lane & Levi Scott, 1850)
benson-commentary-nt-1: The New Testament ... with critical, explanatory, and practical notes, vol. 1: Matthew to the Acts (New York: Carlton & Phillips, 1856)
benson-commentary-nt-2: The New Testament ... with critical, explanatory, and practical notes, vol. 2: Romans to the Revelation (New York: Lane & Tippett, [184-?])

_excluded.benson-other: Sermons and Plans of Sermons (1824-1827) and single sermons left for later; the Gilbert memoirs (another editor)
